home.introText: I build web experiences that feel as good as they work. From the first sketch to the final detail, I bring design and code together to shape each project.

home.aboutText: I'm Oscar Paricio, a web developer. I care about the details: a well-timed transition, text with room to breathe, a button that responds. I enjoy working between design and development to turn ideas into useful interfaces.
home.marquee: Vue · Nuxt · Angular · TypeScript · Node · Anime.js · Motion UI · Accessibility · Performance · Design ·

about.approach: I like to understand what an idea needs before turning it into code. Structure, interaction and finishing touches are all part of the same experience.
about.interests: This portfolio is also a place to experiment: trying ways to navigate, exploring motion and giving interfaces character while keeping them clear.
